# AbeBooks

> > AbeBooks is an online marketplace connecting buyers with independent booksellers worldwide, specializing in rare books, used books, textbooks, first editions, and collectibles since 1996.

The platform serves as a hub for discovering millions of books from independent sellers, with a particular focus on rare and antiquarian books through partnerships with professional associations like ILAB, ABAA, and ABAC. AbeBooks offers curated collections, bargain books under $10, and specialized technical textbooks from publishers like McGraw-Hill and SDC Publications.

## Key Topics

- Rare books and first editions
- Used books and bargain books
- Independent booksellers marketplace
- ILAB (International League of Antiquarian Booksellers)
- ABAA and ABAC professional associations
- Technical textbooks and tutorials
- AutoCAD, Maya, and 3ds Max guides
- SDC Publications and McGraw-Hill
- Collectibles and fine art
- Antiquarian books
- Book search and discovery
- Customer testimonials and seller profiles
- New releases and curated collections

## Getting Started

- [AbeBooks Homepage](https://abebooks.com): Homepage for searching rare books, collectibles, and art from sellers
- [About AbeBooks](https://abebooks.com/about): AbeBooks company history and marketplace overview since 1996
- [Books Hub](https://abebooks.com/books): Main books search hub for used, rare, and bargain books under $10
- [Customer Stories](https://abebooks.com/about/customer-stories): Customer testimonials about finding rare books and supporting sellers

## Book Categories

- [Rare Books](https://abebooks.com/books/rarebooks): Rare, antiquarian, and first edition books from ILAB members
- [Used Books](https://abebooks.com/books/used-books.shtml): Millions of used books from independent sellers worldwide
- [Cheap Books & Textbooks](https://abebooks.com/books/cheap-books-textbooks-used-new/cheapest-books.shtml): Bargain books and textbooks under $10 with discounted prices
- [New Book Releases](https://abebooks.com/books/new-books): New releases featuring Rushdie, Prince Harry, Michelle Obama, and more
- [Curated Collections](https://abebooks.com/collections): Curated collections featuring rare books, art, and collectibles from editors

## Technical Textbooks & Tutorials

- [AutoCAD 2026 Tutorial - 2D Fundamentals](https://abebooks.com/9781630577568/AutoCAD-2026-Tutorial-First-Level-1630577561/plp): AutoCAD 2026 tutorial by Shih & Jumper with video training (SDC)
- [Autodesk Maya 2026 Basics Guide](https://abebooks.com/Autodesk-Maya-2026-Basics-Guide-Kelly/32301757778/bd): Maya 2026 basics guide by Murdock with video tutorials (SDC Publications)
- [Autodesk 3ds Max 2025 Basics Guide](https://abebooks.com/9781630576783/Autodesk-3ds-Max-2025-Basics-1630576786/plp): 3ds Max 2025 basics guide by Murdock for 3D modeling (SDC Publications)
- [Adobe Illustrator 2026 Beginner's Guide](https://abebooks.com/9798269926063/Adobe-Illustrator-2026-Beginner's-Guide/plp): Adobe Illustrator 2026 beginner guide by Momodu for logo & icon design
- [Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs](https://abebooks.com/9780070004849/Structure-Interpretation-Computer-Programs-Second-0070004846/plp): SICP textbook by Abelson & Sussman on Scheme programming (McGraw-Hill)
- [Programmable Logic Controllers](https://abebooks.com/9780073373843/Programmable-Logic-Controllers-Petruzella-Frank-0073373842/plp): PLC programming textbook by Petruzella with LogixPro software (McGraw Hill)
- [Programming and Customizing the 8051 Microcontroller](https://abebooks.com/9780071341929/Programming-Customizing-8051-Microcontroller-Tab-0071341927/plp): 8051 microcontroller programming guide by Predko (McGraw-Hill/TAB)

## Engineering & Electronics Reference

- [Encyclopedia of Electronic Circuits, Volume 7](https://abebooks.com/9780070151154/Encyclopedia-Electronic-Circuits-Volume-7-0070151156/plp): Circuit encyclopedia Vol. 7 by Graf with 1200+ designs (McGraw-Hill)
- [Electromagnetism for Electronic Engineers](https://abebooks.com/9780442306205/Electromagnetism-Electronic-Engineers-Tutorial-Guides-0442306202/plp): Electromagnetism textbook by Carter for engineers (Chapman & Hall)
- [Instrumentation: Transducers and Interfacing](https://abebooks.com/9780412342400/Instrumentation-Transducers-Interfacing-Tutorial-Guides-0412342405/plp): Instrumentation & transducers textbook by Bannister (Springer)
- [PC Hardware FAT FAQs](https://abebooks.com/9780070369399/Hardware-FAT-FAQs-Troubleshooting-Upgrading-0070369399/plp): PC hardware FAQ reference by Bigelow with 1000+ questions (McGraw-Hill)
